messages:
jordan: hey folks — first week here. trying to get Datadog/Grafana/Sentry access for prod. where are the canonical prod dashboards and runbooks? i followed the onboarding doc but some links 403. quick checklist would be amazing.

maria: welcome @jordan! :) quick checklist i usually share: 
• fill the access form: https://intra.redwood.com/access (choose Observability -> Prod)
• request Grafana access (we add you to grafana group `analytics-readers`)
• Sentry: we send an invite to your work email, accept and join the project
• Datadog: request via Support > Observability > Datadog access. include your manager.
If links give 403 it's usually an SSO sync issue — DM me your email and i can escalate.

kevin: fyi prod grafana overview: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/prod/overview?orgId=1 — most prod dashboards are under the "Prod" folder.
Runbooks (incidents/playbooks): https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/observability/prod-incident

jordan: thanks — super helpful. how do i see saved filters and alerts? and is there a pager rotation i need to be on?

maria: saved filters = Explore -> Saved in Grafana. Alerts are in Datadog -> Monitors. Pager rotation info is on People Ops on-call page (wiki -> People Ops -> Oncall).
If you're part of infra-eng we'll add you to rotation when your manager approves; until then you can be added as a watcher on dashboards. we usually tag watchers like `@team-eng-sre` or specific people.

obs-bot: OBSERVABILITY BOT: created ticket #OBS-4321 for access request from jordan. devex will triage during business hours.

kevin: two small tips: if you get 403 after being added, try incognito or clear signin cookies (SSO weirdness).
For Sentry once you accept invite go to Projects -> Redwood-Prod -> Issues.
Also, if you want edit perms on a grafana dashboard paste the dashboard url and @maria will handle.

jordan: sent the access form and DM'd @maria my email. thanks everyone :tada: 

maria: got it — i'll follow up on the ticket and update you here when everything's set. welcome again! :wave:
